hypothesis: The official TrackMan player identifiers contain shared registration structure (length and decimal prefixes/suffixes) that is absent from the anonymous IDs. Coarse completed-history groups may transfer player cohort or role calibration beyond exact-C without importing external identity data.

data_contract.mapping_cutoff: TrackMan-linked rows with season strictly before validation season
data_contract.deployment: frozen anonymous-to-TrackMan ID map from completed official seasons

estimator.history_rows: R only, seasons strictly before validation season
estimator.row_signal: control_success minus its source-season R mean
estimator.group_value: sum of centered signal divided by group count plus k
estimator.apply: add gamma times one group value to exact-C on R; preserve exact-C on F

selection_order: maximum minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021
larger k, smaller gamma, shorter group description

source_gate.on_fail: close without adding ID features to exact-C or reading 2022+ metrics
source_gate.on_pass: freeze one mapped-ID feature recipe and retrain exact-C on 2022 and 2023
